title: MemorySpacesListRequest
description: List spaces visible to the principal; also the receipt drain-barrier read (MEM-R023). Grant: any valid grant in the space, or provider-configured visibility. Read-only; the response payload is returned directly (§7.0.2).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to principal, space, subject, selection/filter, snapshot marker and engine_policy_version. Any state or grant change invalidates it with CURSOR_INVALID (§7.0.7, MEM-R026).
